1.consolidated_definition: Apropiarse subrepticiamente de dinero ajeno. Multan a ex empleado por embolsillarse dinero de AEE. (Primera Hora, 29-05-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To pilfer surreptitiously funds belonging to another person. Fines are imposed on a former employee for embezzling money from the Autoridad de Energía Eléctrica (AEE).
